reviews.review: Can't recommend due to the fact that it is not stable enough to not crash.  First 9 hours of game play are brutally slow, after you get the third quest item it picks up but it takes a long time to get to fun adventure.  Gives a lot of options with very few that are useful or interesting to survive maps.  Enemies randomly spawn in for no plot reason.  In short, takes to long to get fun and might randomly take your progress away because it does not have a periodic auto save to deal with its instability.
Stupid weapon system doesn't let many of the weapons be used.

The game is very interesting; unfortunately performance issues, stuttering and highly unpredictable framerate makes the souls-like-but-with-guns combat sluggish and frustrating to the point of being unplayable. I'm afraid I can't recommend it.

a solid game nothing special but definitely not bad... I actually enjoy playing it if you like Dark Souls and Surge you will probably like this game! maybe with future updates and even another game like this or Immortal Unchained 2 it could be even better and fix a lot of issues and complaints
7/10

After about 5 hours the gameplay became tedious and a chore. The game is full of cheap enemies that teleport around you and shoot/stab you in the back. Or they snipe you from across the map and take 3/4 of your HP. Or they have shields that can block everything except grenade launchers but they gain their stamina back almost instantly and you have to go through it all over again. Or they are just utter jokes and you can 1 tap them in the back. There is no balance at all.

The bosses are an utter joke. I killed every single boss first try except the last one of the DLC which I am currently stuck on due to the adds that spawn in the fight being obnoxious. The enemies in the levels are actually harder than the bosses because of how obnoxious they are.

You cannot respec more than once, I know DS1 had this as well but at least you could still do damage with something. If you end up going for stats to use SMGs and pistols you may as well restart as they do about 10% of the damage of other guns.

I really enjoyed the game at the start because it felt fresh and I liked the idea of a new challenge but my god do I regret it. I am going to finish the game once and uninstall this trash. I only have this 1 last boss to go then I will never touch this again.

I have had no crashing issues but I have had some drastic FPS drops. Im rocking a 2080ti and have seen drops below 30 at times.
IT WAS TOO CLUNKY FOR ME SOME WILL LOVE IT. I DID NOT FIRST TIME I RETURNED A GAME ON STEAM

Biggest grindfest I've seen in a long time. I love the aesthetics and it seems like it would be an interesting world to explore, but the designers are obsessed with making it a soulslike that emphasizes repetition to the point where it is just tedious.
